headlines: INTC about -31% after earnings, top trending on Stocktwits
RDDT -31%, SNDK -15%, AMD -12%, NVDA -5.2%, SOXL -29%, SOXX -9.7%
QQQ -3.97%, IWM -2.0%, SPY -2.05%, GLD -3.5%, TLT flat

rumors.text: Monday could bring a big gap down (April 9th-type move) as weekend risk builds; traders are adding SPY puts into next week
rumors.why: Unsupported speculation and a crowded put bet; if true, a gap lower Monday.

rumors.text: Intel's post-earnings plunge is spreading into semis and growth, an AI-bubble unwind
rumors.why: Price action confirms the weakness but the cause is crowd inference; more chip de-risking would weigh on the index.

rumors.text: No safe haven today: gold down about 3.5%, stocks down and bonds flat, pointing to forced selling or deleveraging; chatter also cites high capex, bond yields and rate worries
rumors.why: Prices fit the story but the cause is unverified; forced liquidation could extend the selloff.

plays.reason: Tech-led washout with fear/greed at 26 and a split crowd; a late bounce is plausible, but the trend is down into the weekend and conviction is low.

readings.whats_new: SPY slid further to about -2.05% (753.62) from -1.55% at the last reading, and QQQ fell to about -4%. Semis deepened their losses (SOXX -9.7%) and gold dropped 3.5% while bonds stayed flat. Stocktwits SPY score is 59 (was 60) with the crowd still split, and chatter now centers on a Monday gap-down and put buying.
